messages:
Asha: Heads-up — I'm oncall swap tonight 18:00->02:00 UTC. Quick pre-oncall checklist below; shout if you see anything off:
- VPN access ✅?
- Pager subscribed and test passing
- KMS/HSM key access for canary rollouts
- Runbooks up-to-date
- Any outstanding PRs that block safe handoff (esp. fallback/rollout)

Liam: VPN ok for me; reissued cert last week. Pagertest ran: `pagerctl send-test --to Liam` succeeded :white_check_mark:

Miguel: Noted VPN cert on my laptop expired yesterday — rekeyed via SSO but hosts still throw `TLS handshake failed` on bastion.
Command I ran:
```
ssh -i ~/.ssh/redwood-bastion miguel@bastion.redwood.internal
```
Workaround: use `ssh -oHostKeyAlgorithms=+ssh-rsa` until infra rotates host keys.

Priya: KMS: if you need data-plane decryption you'll need the rotation key alias `alias/redwood-oncall`. I granted Asha decrypt in staging — confirm if prod required.

Asha: Thanks — can someone confirm prod KMS access? I don't want to escalate during overnight.

Jordan: I can grant prod decrypt if needed, but prefer to avoid changes at midnight. If you need it, DM me and I'll pre-enable for the window. Also flagged PR #4321 (fallback routing) needs one more review — @Liam can you glance? It's small but affects canary fallback.

Liam: Will review now. ETA 20m.

oncall-bot: Reminder: runbook sync scheduled in 30m — https://infra.redwood/runbooks/oncall-prep (last updated by Priya, commit 9d4f2c)

Priya: I pushed a tiny clarifying change to the runbook (added troubleshooting step for `TLS handshake failed`). See commit 9d4f2c

Asha: Pager test for me: `pagerctl send-test --to Asha` — got alert in 8s. :thumbsup:

Miguel: re: bastion, also ensure VPN Split-tunnel is disabled for access to private subnets. I toggled it in the client settings.

Jordan: I'll take the midnight-to-04:00 UTC chunk if anything comes up. Leaving handoff note in ops-docs.

Asha: Logging handoff note: 'Oncall 18:00-02:00 UTC. Watch for increased errors from canary service after 19:30 deploy window. If recurring 5xx, rollback to v2.1.3 using deploy tool and notify infra.'

Liam: PR reviewed and approved. :white_check_mark: Merged and queued for canary.

Priya: Confirmed prod KMS access request — Jordan added Asha for the oncall window.

Asha: All good. If anything else, ping here. Leaving "oncall-ready" status in Ops channel.

oncall-bot: Handoff marker set by Asha at 1738004321
